grammar.summary: 本课讲述重返故里却迷路的故事，集中运用了过去完成时、定语从句与 must have done 推测。课文用过去完成时表达「先于过去」的动作（母亲去世、父亲描述路线），用 which/that 引导定语从句修饰地图册与村庄，用 must have 表示对过去事实的推测。

points.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect)
points.explanation: had + 过去分词表示「先于过去某一时间点」已完成的动作。本课用 had died 表示母亲去世先于父亲决定移居，用 had described 表示父亲曾反复描述路线先于「我」迷路，时间层次清晰。

examples.en: When my mother had died after a tragic accident, he did not quickly recover from the shock and loneliness.
examples.cn: 当时我母亲在一次事故中惨死，父亲未能很快从悲痛与孤独中恢复过来。

examples.en: But my father had described over and over again what we should see at every milestone, after leaving the nearest town, so that I was positive I should recognize it as familiar territory.
examples.cn: 而是父亲曾详细给我讲了，在过了离故乡最近的那个小镇后，在每一个路标处可见到些什么。因此，我相信这段路对我来说会是很熟悉的。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 which/that 引导定语从句修饰先行词。本课用 which 修饰 book of maps（地图册），并用两个并列的 which 从句分别说明它的有用与无用，用 that 修饰 the village。

examples.en: I hired a car the day after landing and bought a comprehensive book of maps, which I found most helpful on the cross-country journey, but which I did not think I should need on the last stage.
examples.cn: 我下飞机后租了一辆车，并买了一本详尽的地图册。在乡间行车途中，我觉得它非常有用，但快到家了，我倒觉得它没什么用了。

examples.en: The village no longer existed because it had been submerged, and all the valley too.
examples.cn: 村庄已不复存在，因为已经为水所淹，山谷也被水淹没了。

points.title: must have done 推测 (Past Deduction)
points.explanation: must have + 过去分词表示对过去事实的肯定推测，意为「一定……」。本课用 must have taken a wrong turning 推断自己一定拐错了弯，用 must have misunderstood 推断骑马人一定误解了自己。

examples.en: I decided that I must have taken a wrong turning somewhere.
examples.cn: 我想一定是什么地方拐错了弯儿。

examples.en: I thought he must have misunderstood me, so I repeated its name.
examples.cn: 我想他一定误解了我的意思，于是又说一遍村庄的名字。

exercises.q: When my mother ______ after a tragic accident, he did not quickly recover from the shock and loneliness.
I decided that I ______ taken a wrong turning somewhere.
I hired a car the day after landing and bought a comprehensive book of maps, ______ I found most helpful on the cross-country journey, but ______ I did not think I should need on the last stage.
用过去完成时填空：But my father ______ (describe) over and over again what we should see at every milestone, after leaving the nearest town, so that I was positive I should recognize it as familiar territory.
课文中 everything still seemed alien to me 中 alien 的含义最接近？
